screening_method_note: This pass is a heuristic first-pass screen of every `description` value against a bounded, documented term list (the 54 terms in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's operating list -- the 20 canonical core Golarion deities plus a sampled set of known setting place names -- the same list used for the 4 in-scope books' retro-fit). Zero matches were found across all 127 of this book's licensed content records: 17 feats + 42 equipment modifiers, screened 2026-07-27 by src/bin/sd27_gen_book_cache.rs's gen_pathfinder_unchained(), plus 4 classes + 64 class features, screened 2026-07-31 by src/bin/ingest_pu_classes.rs's pi_hits() against the identical term list. Consistent with this book's own subject matter (alignment/stamina/wound-threshold feats, Automatic Bonus Progression equipment modifiers, and the four Unchained class chassis/feature trees) being entirely rules-mechanical, setting-neutral text. The count above was stale at 59 until 2026-07-31 because it was written from what one generator emitted rather than from the book's record set; tests/sd27_book_license_record_counts.rs now derives it from disk so that cannot silently recur. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan against 54 known names and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see.
